newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 988 bln lire of Italy 3-yr Btp.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 988 bln lire of Italy 3-yr Btp.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for 988 billion lire of three-year fixed-rate bonds (BTP) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 450 billion lire of paper.
They also bid for 1,080 billion of five year Btps against the Treasury's offer of 400 billion.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 9.59 trillion lire at the open auction for the February 15, 2000 paper, against 4.5 trillion lire worth of Btps on offer.
The auction price was set at 96.65 from 97.55 at the previous three-year Btp auction in mid March.
Bids for 9.61 trillion lire worth of five year Btps were also received at the open auction against the Treasury's offer of 4.0 trillion.
The auction price was set at 94.80 against 96.50 previously.
